title: The demo pages' login, POST /rest/saiku/session/ (trailing slash), signs in again; nothing beneath /rest/saiku/session/ is reopened

criteria.given: an anonymous caller with no cookies posting the demo credentials form-encoded to /rest/saiku/session/, the exact URL embed-demo, aqvira-demo and both showcase pages use
criteria.then: the login answers 200 and sets a session cookie, and a later call carrying only that cookie is authenticated as that user

criteria.given: an anonymous caller posting credentials to a path beneath /rest/saiku/session/ (the removed /clear, or any other sub-path)
criteria.then: the request is refused (403, 404 or 405) and never answers 200; an anonymous GET beneath it is not permitted either (401 or 403)
